messages:
Carla: Kicking off an experiment to compare SmoothQuant + activation-aware AWQ hybrid vs GPTQ and FP8 for 128k KV cache. Plan: eval perplexity (Wiki test), EM on QA prompts, and E2E latency at 64k/128k contexts. Any immediate concerns?

Ben: sounds good. which model and config exactly?

Carla: model = rw-instruct-13b-v2 (fp32 baseline). Variants: 1) GPTQ int8, 2) AWQ int8, 3) SmoothQuant -> AWQ hybrid (apply SQ scaling to activations before AWQ), 4) FP8 dynamic. Also add a mix-quant baseline (weights int8, kv-cache fp16).

Alex: +1 for mix-quant. we should track per-token log-probs so regression alerts can pick up subtle shifts.

Carla: seeds=3, batch_sizes=[1,8], context_lengths=[65536,131072]. Metrics: ppl, EM, 50/90/99th token latency, throughput, peak GPU mem.

Dan: FYI runtime needs a tiny KV handoff patch for 128k to avoid memcpy thrashing. i'll land a branch tonight @carla :hammer_and_wrench:

InfraBot: deploy-bench: queued job bench-128k-1762345678 on pool=ded-gpu-a. link: https://internal/bench/1762345678 :rocket:

Ben: quick config snippet I used for AWQ hybrid:
```
--model rw-instruct-13b-v2
--quant algo=awq
--smoothquant=true
--smoothquant_blocksize=4096
--kv_dtype=fp16
--context_lengths=65536,131072
--batch_sizes=1,8
--seeds=3
```

Carla: preliminary results (seed1, batch=1, 128k):
- FP32 baseline: ppl=12.40, 99th_token_latency=78ms, peak_gpu=19.2GB, throughput=7.2 t/s
- GPTQ int8: ppl=12.80 (+3.2%), 99th=64ms, peak=12.5GB, throughput=9.1 t/s
- AWQ int8: ppl=12.60 (+1.6%), 99th=68ms, peak=11.9GB, throughput=8.7 t/s
- SmoothQuant->AWQ hybrid: ppl=12.45 (+0.4%), 99th=70ms, peak=11.6GB, throughput=8.3 t/s
- FP8 dynamic: ppl=12.90 (+4.0%), 99th=60ms, peak=10.3GB, throughput=9.6 t/s

Ben: oof hybrid looks promising — near-baseline ppl with good mem savings. any stability issues?

Alex: observed 2 small quality dips on long-prefix QA (EM -0.8% vs fp32) — logged in eval PR #512. Also hybrid had a couple of token-prob spikes after very long prefixes (~>100k) where softmax scale shifted.

Carla: noted. we should try hybrid with kv_dtype=float32 to see if that removes the spikes (trade mem for stability).

Priya: can we try SmoothQuant with blockwise activation stats (smaller block) to reduce the drift? might cost a bit of time but could help.

Dan: patched runtime: kv_handshake v2 applied and improved memcpy pattern. re-ran profile on hybrid + kv_fp32 variant, single seed. logs: https://internal/logs/1762345678/profile.txt

Carla: quick re-run (hybrid, kv_fp32): ppl=12.43 (+0.24%), 99th=75ms, peak_gpu=14.8GB — quality back to near-baseline, small latency cost. Worth it for Dedicated customers with strict accuracy SLOs.

Ben: nice. next steps: run full 3 seeds for all variants, add hybrid-kv_fp32 and hybrid-kv_fp16 arms, and expand eval to 10k prompts (mix of long-context QA and assistant-style). I'll queue the extra runs; ping if infra job dies :eyes:

Carla: thanks — I'll collate full numbers and draft a short recommendation for product on hybrid as a candidate for 'recommended quant profile' for long-context workloads. Also: add a regression test that fails if EM drops >1.0% or ppl rises >2.5% compared to fp32 on the long-context eval set. :memo:

Alex: thumbs up. if hybrid passes stability across seeds we can add it to the model catalog with a note: "activation-aware SmoothQuant + AWQ hybrid — good tradeoff for long contexts"

Priya: I'll try smaller SQ blocksize experiment tomorrow AM.

Carla: awesome, team. I'll post the final bakeoff summary once the 3-seed sweep completes. :party:
